surface.name: Cortex REST API Chat Completions
surface.selection_basis: Snowflake's current Cortex REST quickstart supports the OpenAI Chat Completions format with a Snowflake account URL, programmatic access token, and model name.

alternatives_considered.name: Cortex Messages API
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: It is limited to Claude models, while Chat Completions supports the broader catalog.

alternatives_considered.name: AI_COMPLETE SQL function
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: It is a SQL surface rather than the selected developer-facing REST API.

entry_point.developer_intent: Configure Snowflake Cortex REST access and receive model-generated content from Chat Completions.
assumed_prior_state: No Snowflake account access, Cortex role grant, PAT, or model selection exists.
A browser and cURL are available.

documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated Cortex REST Chat Completions request returns generated assistant content.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format and contains assistant content in choices.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The Cortex REST page provides a Chat Completions quickstart and POST /api/v2/cortex/v1/chat/completions reference.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The first returned assistant message completes the model API job, while Snowflake account, role, token, budget, and model state remain platform prerequisites.

prerequisites.requirement: Access to a Snowflake account enabled for Cortex REST API.
A role with the SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX_USER database role and model access.
A Snowflake programmatic access token or another supported REST token.
The Snowflake account identifier and an available model name.

primary_path.action: Sign in to a Snowflake account enabled for Cortex REST API.
primary_path.success_signal: Cortex and user security settings are reachable.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Account edition, region, administrator, or REST enablement can block access.

primary_path.action: Grant the user a role with SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX_USER and access to the intended model.

primary_path.success_signal: The token is stored for the REST request.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Security policy can restrict token generation.

primary_path.action: Choose an available model and form the account-specific Cortex base URL.
primary_path.success_signal: Both values are valid for the account.

primary_path.action: POST model and messages to /api/v2/cortex/v1/chat/completions with the Bearer token.
primary_path.input: Account URL, PAT, model, and messages
primary_path.success_signal: The API returns a successful completion.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Authorization, model, budget, quota, or request errors block output.

primary_path.action: Confirm generated assistant content is present in choices.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An error body does not meet the boundary.

branches.condition: The selected model is Claude and the developer prefers Anthropic semantics.
branches.path: Use the Cortex Messages API and Anthropic SDK-compatible base URL.
branches.effect_on_first_success: Changes request format but not Snowflake prerequisites.

friction_gates.description: The account must be enabled for Cortex REST API.
The calling user needs Cortex role access.
A supported REST token is required.
Consumption budget and quota can block a request.

uncertainties.question: Which account editions, regions, and trial accounts are enabled for Cortex REST by default?
uncertainties.impact: Could add procurement or administrator gates before role and token setup.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The REST page describes the enabled-account prerequisite but not universal account eligibility.
